SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings
SiteSettings.description: Global storefront configuration for Dilan Studio including master Fiverr category links and the homepage hero showcase image.

patternsGigUrl.description: Master Fiverr Gig URL applied to all Seamless Patterns products.

mylarGigUrl.description: Master Fiverr Gig URL applied to all Mylar Bags products.

heroImageUrl.description: Public URL of the homepage hero showcase banner image.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last settings update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin user who updated the settings.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A portfolio design item showcased on Dilan Studio under Seamless Patterns or Mylar Bags.

category.description: Parent category determining which master Fiverr Gig URL is used.

imageUrl.description: Firebase Storage download URL or studio asset path.

storagePath.description: Optional Firebase Storage object path for cleanup on deletion.

createdBy.description: Immutable UID of the admin who created this product.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Registry of authorized Dilan Studio administrators.

/siteSettings/{settingId}.description: Public storefront configuration document (`public`) storing master Fiverr category links and hero image URL.

/products/{productId}.description: Portfolio design products publicly visible on the showcase and managed by admins.

/admins/{userId}.description: Authorized admin users for Dilan Studio.
